name: W21 Ads sync (hourly insights -> ad_metrics + ad_objects)

parameters.content: W21 Ads sync. Hourly at :07. Insights are NEVER fetched more often than hourly (meta-ads.js refuses with TOO_SOON). Back-off at 80% of X-Business-Use-Case-Usage (0.3 #11): on RATE_LIMIT_BACKOFF this run ends quietly and the next hour retries; 3 consecutive back-offs -> W22 warning. Reads only: no ad changes here. Needs: META_SYSTEM_USER_TOKEN, META_API_VERSION in n8n env; repo automation/ mounted read-only at /opt/lv/automation; NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto; N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false. Credential: "LV Supabase - n8n_app (least privilege)". Writes: ad_metrics (ON CONFLICT date, ad_id, placement; placement 'all' when the insights row has no breakdown; generated cpl/cost_per_* never written), brands.insights_last_fetched_at, ad_objects (status/budget cache for the console and W30).

nodes.name: Load brands with an ad account

parameters.query: SELECT id AS brand_id, ad_account_id, insights_last_fetched_at FROM brands WHERE ad_account_id IS NOT NULL AND is_active;

-- cpl / cost_per_qualified / cost_per_attended / cost_per_good_fit are GENERATED columns: never inserted or updated.
WITH up AS (
INSERT INTO public.ad_metrics (date, brand_id, campaign_id, campaign_name, adset_id, adset_name, ad_id, ad_name, concept, angle, format, placement, spend_zar, impressions, clicks, leads_raw, frequency, hook_rate, hold_rate)
SELECT x.date, x.brand_id, x.campaign_id, x.campaign_name, x.adset_id, x.adset_name, x.ad_id, x.ad_name, x.concept, x.angle, x.format, coalesce(x.placement, 'all'), x.spend_zar, x.impressions, x.clicks, x.leads_raw, x.frequency, x.hook_rate, x.hold_rate
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(date date, brand_id uuid, campaign_id text, campaign_name text, adset_id text, adset_name text, ad_id text, ad_name text, concept text, angle text, format text, placement text, spend_zar numeric, impressions bigint, clicks bigint, leads_raw int, frequency numeric, hook_rate numeric, hold_rate numeric)
ON CONFLICT (date, ad_id, placement) DO UPDATE SET campaign_name = EXCLUDED.campaign_name, adset_name = EXCLUDED.adset_name, ad_name = EXCLUDED.ad_name, concept = EXCLUDED.concept, angle = EXCLUDED.angle, format = EXCLUDED.format, spend_zar = EXCLUDED.spend_zar, impressions = EXCLUDED.impressions, clicks = EXCLUDED.clicks, leads_raw = EXCLUDED.leads_raw, frequency = EXCLUDED.frequency, hook_rate = EXCLUDED.hook_rate, hold_rate = EXCLUDED.hold_rate, synced_at = now()
-- qualified / booked / attended are NOT touched here: the join below (and W29 for broker quality) own them.
RETURNING 1)
SELECT count(*)::int AS upserted FROM up;

-- leads.qualified is a generated boolean (06). cost_per_qualified is a GENERATED column on ad_metrics: it recomputes itself when qualified changes.
WITH s AS (SELECT ad_id, (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date AS d, count(*) FILTER (WHERE qualified) AS q FROM public.leads WHERE brand_id = $1::uuid AND ad_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at > now() - interval '5 days' GROUP BY 1, 2),
u AS (UPDATE public.ad_metrics m SET qualified = s.q FROM s WHERE m.ad_id = s.ad_id AND m.date = s.d AND m.brand_id = $1::uuid RETURNING 1)
SELECT count(*)::int AS joined FROM u;

nodes.name: Back-off or too soon: retry next hour

parameters.query: WITH u AS (UPDATE public.brands SET insights_last_fetched_at = $2::timestamptz WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*)::int AS stamped FROM u;

WITH up AS (
INSERT INTO public.ad_objects (id, level, brand_id, campaign_id, adset_id, name, status, effective_status, daily_budget_zar, lifetime_budget_zar, spend_cap_zar, creative_id, effective_object_story_id, ig_media_id, launched_at, fetched_at)
SELECT x.id, x.level, x.brand_id, x.campaign_id, x.adset_id, x.name, x.status, x.effective_status, x.daily_budget_zar, x.lifetime_budget_zar, x.spend_cap_zar, x.creative_id, x.effective_object_story_id, x.ig_media_id, x.launched_at, now()
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(id text, level text, brand_id uuid, campaign_id text, adset_id text, name text, status text, effective_status text, daily_budget_zar numeric, lifetime_budget_zar numeric, spend_cap_zar numeric, creative_id text, effective_object_story_id text, ig_media_id text, launched_at timestamptz)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET level = EXCLUDED.level, campaign_id = EXCLUDED.campaign_id, adset_id = EXCLUDED.adset_id, name = EXCLUDED.name, status = EXCLUDED.status, effective_status = EXCLUDED.effective_status,
  daily_budget_zar = EXCLUDED.daily_budget_zar, lifetime_budget_zar = EXCLUDED.lifetime_budget_zar, spend_cap_zar = EXCLUDED.spend_cap_zar, creative_id = EXCLUDED.creative_id,
  effective_object_story_id = coalesce(EXCLUDED.effective_object_story_id, public.ad_objects.effective_object_story_id), ig_media_id = coalesce(EXCLUDED.ig_media_id, public.ad_objects.ig_media_id),
  launched_at = coalesce(public.ad_objects.launched_at, EXCLUDED.launched_at), fetched_at = now()
-- last_budget_change_at is owned by the confirm-to-apply write path (console), never by this read-only sync.
RETURNING 1)
SELECT count(*)::int AS cached FROM up;
